notes: Proposed semantic messages for ToolsPage and its directly rendered tool/MCP/A2A/editor/test surfaces. Raw tool names, employee names, URLs, commands, paths, protocol values, test arguments, and provider responses remain data and are not catalog entries.

entries.en-US: Search by name, description, URL, or bucket
entries.zh-CN: 搜索工具名称、描述、URL 或分桶

entries.en-US: {count, plural, =0 {No tools} one {# tool} other {# tools}}
entries.zh-CN: {count, plural, =0 {没有工具} other {# 个工具}}

entries.en-US: {count, plural, =0 {No imported tools will be deleted.} one {# imported tool will be deleted with it; this cannot be undone.} other {# imported tools will be deleted with it; this cannot be undone.}}
entries.zh-CN: {count, plural, =0 {没有已导入工具会被删除。} other {其下 # 个已导入工具将一并删除，操作不可撤销。}}

entries.en-US: {count, plural, =0 {No tools will be removed from this employee.} one {# tool will be removed from this employee; the server and other employees are unchanged.} other {# tools will be removed from this employee; the server and other employees are unchanged.}}
entries.zh-CN: {count, plural, =0 {当前员工没有工具会被移除。} other {将从当前员工移除该工具集的 # 个工具，工具集本身和其他员工不受影响。}}

entries.en-US: Copy available tools from the open plaza; copied tools become local bindings for the current employee.
entries.zh-CN: 从开放广场复制可用工具；复制后会成为当前员工的本地工具绑定。

entries.en-US: Copy available tools from an employee; inaccessible content is omitted.
entries.zh-CN: 从数字员工复制可用工具；不可见内容不会出现在列表。

entries.en-US: Deleting it prevents skills that reference this tool from calling it. This action cannot be undone.
entries.zh-CN: 删除后，引用该工具的技能将无法继续调用它，操作不可撤销。

entries.en-US: Removing it from this employee does not delete the original tool in the plaza.
entries.zh-CN: 从当前员工移除后，工具广场中的原始工具不会被删除。

entries.en-US: No tools yet. Select “Create” to add one.
entries.zh-CN: 暂无工具，点击「新建」创建一个吧

entries.en-US: Choose a tool type and fill in its definition. You can test requests and responses in the probe panel.
entries.zh-CN: 选择工具类型并填写定义，可先用右侧探测区测试请求与返回结构。

entries.en-US: Update the tool definition and validate the current or saved configuration in the side panel.
entries.zh-CN: 修改工具定义，并在右侧验证当前配置或已保存版本。

entries.en-US: Invoke a saved tool with test parameters to inspect the response available to employees.
entries.zh-CN: 用测试参数直接调用已保存工具，检查员工后续调用时的实际返回。

entries.en-US: Configure an MCP Server, discover its tools, and sync them into a tool group.
entries.zh-CN: 配置 MCP Server 连接后，可发现其提供的工具并同步为工具集。

entries.en-US: The name cannot be changed after saving.
Unique identifier: letters, numbers, and underscores only; non-Latin input is transliterated; maximum 15 characters.
entries.zh-CN: 作为唯一标识，仅支持字母/数字/下划线；中文将自动转拼音，最长 15 字符。

entries.en-US: Disabled tools in this group cannot be called by employees.
entries.zh-CN: 停用后其下工具将无法被员工调用。

entries.en-US: Disabled tools cannot be called by employees.
entries.zh-CN: 停用后员工将无法调用该工具。

entries.en-US: Stop if discovery fails instead of continuing.
entries.zh-CN: 发现失败时终止而非继续尝试

entries.en-US: Keep protocol extension fields; structured options are mirrored here.
entries.zh-CN: 保留协议扩展字段；结构化选项会同步写入这里。

entries.en-US: Configure a single HTTP endpoint as a tool.
entries.zh-CN: 配置单个 HTTP 接口作为工具

entries.en-US: Call a remote agent through A2A SendMessage.
entries.zh-CN: 通过 A2A SendMessage 调用远程智能体

entries.en-US: Connect an MCP Server, discover its tools, and sync its tool set.
entries.zh-CN: 连接 MCP Server，自动发现并同步其工具集

entries.en-US: Connect to a remote MCP Server through HTTP(S).
entries.zh-CN: 通过 HTTP(S) 连接远程 MCP Server

entries.en-US: Connect to a remote MCP Server through Server-Sent Events.
entries.zh-CN: 通过 Server-Sent Events 连接远程 MCP Server

entries.en-US: Start a local process and communicate through standard input/output.
entries.zh-CN: 启动本地进程并通过标准输入输出通信

entries.en-US: Use the built-in builtin.demo MCP for demonstration only.
entries.zh-CN: 使用内置的 builtin.demo MCP，仅用于演示
开启 MCP Apps 扩展协议

entries.en-US: Enables negotiation of io.modelcontextprotocol/ui and MCP App rendering; 10 MiB maximum per App.
entries.zh-CN: 开启后协商 io.modelcontextprotocol/ui，并允许渲染 MCP App；单个 App 资源最大 10 MiB。
命令 {command} · 最长 {timeoutSeconds, number} 秒 · {credentialStatus}

entries.en-US: Tasks, events, artifacts, and state are persisted.
entries.zh-CN: 任务、事件、产物和状态会持久化。

entries.en-US: No A2A call records. Test or invoke the tool to retain long-task state here.
entries.zh-CN: 尚无 A2A 调用记录。测试或正式调用后，长任务状态会保留在这里。
{updatedAt} · {eventCount, number} 个事件 · {artifactCount, number} 个产物
{count, plural, =0 {0 次恢复} other {# 次恢复}}

entries.en-US: Click “Discover tools” to fetch tools/list, then select and “Import / sync” to create tool rows.
entries.zh-CN: 点击「发现工具」拉取 tools/list，勾选后「导入/同步」即可生成工具行。

entries.en-US: Save the MCP server before importing and syncing tools.
entries.zh-CN: 请先保存 MCP 服务器，才能导入并同步工具。

entries.en-US: Create or select an employee before copying tools
entries.zh-CN: 请先创建或选择一个数字员工，再复制工具
请选择要复制到的数字员工

entries.en-US: {importedCount, plural, one {Copied # tool} other {Copied # tools}}{missingCount, plural, =0 {} other {; # not copied}}
entries.zh-CN: {importedCount, plural, one {已复制 # 个工具} other {已复制 # 个工具}}{missingCount, plural, =0 {} other {；未复制 # 个}}

entries.en-US: Failed to load A2A task records
entries.zh-CN: 加载 A2A 任务记录失败
取消 A2A 任务失败
加载 MCP 服务器失败
请填写 MCP 服务器名称

entries.en-US: Save the MCP server before syncing tools
entries.zh-CN: 请先保存 MCP 服务器，再同步工具

entries.en-US: Select at least one tool to sync
entries.zh-CN: 请至少选择一个要导入的工具

entries.en-US: Sync complete: {importedCount, number} imported, {updatedCount, number} updated
entries.zh-CN: 同步完成：新增 {importedCount, number}，更新 {updatedCount, number}

entries.en-US: Test arguments are not valid JSON
entries.zh-CN: 测试参数不是合法 JSON

entries.en-US: When the URL already has query parameters, switch HTTP Method to GET; POST sends test parameters as a JSON body.
entries.zh-CN: URL 已包含查询参数时请把 HTTP Method 切换为 GET；POST 会把测试参数作为 JSON Body 发送。

entries.en-US: JSON configuration is invalid; check Headers, Auth, Schema, or protocol options.
entries.zh-CN: JSON 配置格式不正确，请检查 Headers、Auth、Schema 或协议配置

entries.en-US: Headers and environment variables must be valid JSON
entries.zh-CN: Headers 或环境变量必须是合法 JSON
简单说明这个工具集的用途
简单说明这个工具的用途

entries.en-US: Each tool supports 1–3600 seconds; A2A long tasks remain subscribed or polled within this timeout.
entries.zh-CN: 每个工具独立生效，支持 1–3600 秒；A2A 长任务会在此时间内持续订阅或轮询。

entries.en-US: Leave blank to allow all skills; separate multiple skills with English commas.
entries.zh-CN: 留空表示所有技能可调用，多个技能用英文逗号分隔。

entries.en-US: Automatically discover the Agent Card; prefer streaming subscription and fall back to polling after disconnect. StaffDeck persists tasks, events, and artifacts.
entries.zh-CN: 自动发现 Agent Card；优先流式订阅，断线后回退轮询。任务、事件和产物由 StaffDeck 持久化。

entries.en-US: Test the current connection without saving.
entries.zh-CN: 无需保存，直接用当前配置测试连接。

entries.en-US: Test arguments JSON (appended to URL query)
entries.zh-CN: 测试参数 JSON（拼到 URL Query）

entries.en-US: Test arguments JSON (sent as request body)
entries.zh-CN: 测试参数 JSON（作为请求 Body）

entries.en-US: GET appends fields as query parameters; enter unencoded values, for example timezone as Asia/Shanghai.
entries.zh-CN: GET 会把这里的字段作为查询参数追加到 URL；参数值填写未编码原文，例如 timezone 用 Asia/Shanghai。

entries.en-US: POST sends these fields as a JSON body.
entries.zh-CN: POST 会把这些字段作为 JSON Body 发送。

entries.en-US: Invoke saved “{name}” to verify the response available to employees.
entries.zh-CN: 调用已保存的「{name}」，用于验证员工实际可用的工具返回。

entries.en-US: After invoking, the tool response, error information, and raw data will appear here.
entries.zh-CN: 点击调用后，这里会显示工具返回、错误信息和原始 data。
